# JSON Resume Even conversion

Manual declarative port of the layout hierarchy and light palette at upstream commit `8231a31977aa7bfc7c1724713b523a85f32a760d`.

The port does not copy or execute upstream JavaScript or CSS. Feather icons, dark-mode switching, timeline pseudo-elements, Markdown interpretation, runtime color overrides and upstream dependencies are intentionally omitted. No upstream font, icon or image asset is redistributed. JadeAI uses its bundled Noto Sans SC font and standard declarative document blocks.
